01_apps/fast_lio/workspace/src/fast_lio/.text:
common:
    lid_topic:  "/livox/lidar"
    imu_topic:  "/livox/imu"
    time_sync_en: false        # ONLY turn on when external time synchronization is really not possible
    time_offset_lidar_to_imu: 0.0 # Time offset between lidar and IMU calibrated by other algorithms, e.g. LI-Init (can be found in README).
                                  # This param will take effect no matter what time_sync_en is. So if the time offset is not known exactly, please set as 0.0

preprocess:
    lidar_type: 1                # 1 for Livox serials LiDAR, 2 for Velodyne LiDAR, 3 for ouster LiDAR, 
    scan_line: 4
    blind: 0.5

mapping:
    # acc_cov: 0.1
    # gyr_cov: 0.1
    # b_acc_cov: 0.0001
    # b_gyr_cov: 0.0001
    # acc_cov:   4.32e-3      # ≈ acc_n^2 
    # gyr_cov:   9.03e-3      # ≈ gyr_n^2 
    # b_acc_cov: 7.3e-14      # ≈ acc_w^2 
    # b_gyr_cov: 1.1e-12      # ≈ gyr_w^2 

    acc_cov: 1.1513e-1   # = acc_n^2
    gyr_cov: 2.6470e-1   # = gyr_n^2
    # bias random walk（cov_bias_acc, cov_bias_gyr）
    b_acc_cov: 1.80e-4  # = acc_w^2
    b_gyr_cov: 2.92e-4   # = gyr_w^2



    fov_degree:    360
    det_range:     100.0
    extrinsic_est_en:  false      # true: enable the online estimation of IMU-LiDAR extrinsic
    extrinsic_T: [ -0.011, -0.02329, 0.04412 ]
    extrinsic_R: [ 1, 0, 0,
                   0, 1, 0,
                   0, 0, 1]

publish:
    path_en:  false
    scan_publish_en:  true       # false: close all the point cloud output
    dense_publish_en: true       # false: low down the points number in a global-frame point clouds scan.
    scan_bodyframe_pub_en: true  # true: output the point cloud scans in IMU-body-frame

pcd_save:
    pcd_save_en: false
    interval: -1                 # how many LiDAR frames saved in each pcd file; 
                                 # -1 : all frames will be saved in ONE pcd file, may lead to memory crash when having too much frames.

02_drivers/sensors/share/livox_ros_drive.text:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

PIDS=()

cleanup(){
        for pid in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
                if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
                        kill "$pid"
                fi
        done
        wait
}

trap cleanup TERM INT HUP

source "/opt/ros/noetic/setup.bash"
source "/home/orangepi/drone_platform/02_drivers/sensors/setup.bash"

# source "~/.bashrc"
export ROS_HOSTNAME=orangepi5ultra
export ROS_MASTER_URI=http://localhost:11311/

sleep 3
roslaunch mavros px4.launch &
PIDS+=($!)


sleep 13
# --- Orbbec: identical stack/params to source (TECH_DEMO package), SDK 2.10.6 ---
# SDK dir must come first, otherwise libOrbbecSDK.so.2 resolves to the old 2.5.5 in TECH/lib.
for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | grep '[o]rbbec_camera_node' | sed 's/^ *//' | cut -d' ' -f1); do
        kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
rm -f /dev/shm/orbbec_device.lock
source "/home/orangepi/drone_platform/02_drivers/orbbec/devel/setup.bash"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/orangepi/drone_platform/02_drivers/orbbec/src/OrbbecSDK_ROS1-2-main/SDK/lib/arm64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
roslaunch orbbec_camera gemini_330_series.launch \
        color_width:=1280 color_height:=720 \
        depth_width:=848 depth_height:=480 \
        enable_color:=true enable_depth:=true enable_point_cloud:=true \
        enable_left_ir:=true enable_right_ir:=true \
        enable_accel:=false enable_gyro:=false \
        enable_frame_sync:=false &
PIDS+=($!)

sleep 3
roslaunch usb_cam usb_cam.launch &
PIDS+=($!)


sleep 25
roslaunch livox_ros_driver2 msg_MID360s.launch &
PIDS+=($!)



# sleep 10
# roslaunch fast_lio mapping_mid360.launch &
# PIDS+=($!)

# sleep 3
# roslaunch to_mavros vision2mavros.launch &
# PIDS+=($!)


source "/home/orangepi/drone_platform/01_apps/basic_demo/devel/setup.bash" --extend
source "/home/orangepi/drone_platform/01_apps/mission_demo/devel/setup.bash" --extend
sleep 3
roslaunch rtsp_test rtsp_test.launch &
PIDS+=($!)


for pid in "${PIDS[@]}"; do
        wait "$pid" || {
                exit 1
        }
done
